story:
In this worked example, the Eagles would share their GivesBack link through the club Facebook page, newsletter and clubrooms hire-pack.

If three supporters commissioned a Brand Sprint, an Idea Engine batch and a website + logo package at the example values shown, the 10% contribution would total $720.

These are hypothetical projects and earnings. The club history on the detail page is separate from this example.
math:
Illustrative project values and 10% contribution

Brand Sprint ($2,500)$250
Idea Engine ($1,500)$150
Website + Logo ($3,200)$320
Example contribution$720.00

Illustrative amounts, not a quote or recorded earnings. AUD for Australian examples; NZD for New Zealand examples.
